notes.title: Hotfix v1.19
notes.notes:
Fixed 'A Little Help' achievement not saving the progress.
 Fixed floating when being knocked unconscious by the flower smell in mid-air.

notes.title: Patch v1.17
notes.notes:
​Menus now fully supports controllers.
Removed Gamepad bindings button due to a bug making it unfunctional. 
Fixed Witch's projectiles continuing its movement when the game is paused.

notes.title: Hotfix v1.16
notes.notes:
Fixed crouching near walls to the left teleporting players above
 Fixed sliding into moving platforms teleporting players above
 Fixed achievement 'Horny at All Costs', updated it's description


Hello everyone, hope you are enjoying the game! 

I'm working on the next update as I'm fixing the bugs I can find(or see in gameplay videos). Achievement 'Horny at All Costs' was initially designed for a difficult area in stage 9 on development stage at Itch but then I moved it to stage 11 and forgot to update it, sorry about this. As for other achievements, keep in mind that there is a new girl introduced after stage 12 so you won't be able to complete some achievements without playing stage 13 at least(there are a total of 5 hostile and 4 friendly girls). If you are certain it's bugged, please let me know.

As for the other existing bugs, it might seem they are obvious but I fix anything I can find and some are specific to certain scenarios so if you could drop in our Discord  channel and share the information, that would help a lot!
